summary: Enviri II Corp (New Enviri) filed an 8-K detailing the spin-off of Harsco Environmental and Rail segments into a standalone public company, concurrent with the sale of Clean Earth to Veolia. Terms: Enviri stockholders receive one share of New Enviri common stock for every three shares of Enviri common stock, plus $15.00 per share in cash from the Clean Earth sale after debt repayment and costs. The spin-off is expected to close June 1, 2026; when-issued trading (NVRI WI) starts May 27, regular way (NVRI) June 2. The board approved, and a prior information statement was filed May 8. What to watch: closing conditions satisfaction and post-spin trading dynamics.
